title.narrative: Environmentally sound management of polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB) - containing equipment and wastes and upgrade of technical expertise in Bolivia

description.narrative: .Related to PPG Phase, ID 130175 - The aim of the project is to strengthen national capacities for the environmentallysound management (ESM) of PCBs, including disposal of up to 400 tones of PCBand related wastes and reduction / elimination of PCB releases from serviced electrical equipment at workshops and interim storage locations, to avoid crosscontamination of electrical equipment and to protect human health and the environment.
